feature: Security Intelligence: Daily Alert Volume drill-down (part of epic #1045). AlertVolumeCard.tsx (/security-overview page) previously showed only aggregate fired/resolved counts per day. Clicking a day bar now opens a Dialog listing the real per-signal (label + direction) breakdown for that day, sourced from the same GET /api/portal/engines/security/history signalDeltas the aggregate counts were already built from (engine_score_signal_deltas via tenant_engine_snapshots, signalKey/label resolved through signal_rule_groups). No new backend endpoint or query — the label/signalKey fields were already returned by the route, just discarded during per-day aggregation in useSecurityOverviewLive.ts's bucketSignalDeltas().
notes: REAL DATA CONFIRMED (shaneapp://executeSql, 2026-08-17): the testbed tenant (customer_id=1) has real engine_score_signal_deltas rows for engine_key='security' dated 2026-08-15 (within the default 7d chart window, since today is 2026-08-17), including signal_key='security:lacks_defender', direction='fired', which resolves via signal_rule_groups to the real label 'Lacks Defender for Office 365 Conditions' — D1 pins on this exact known signalKey/label pair (same JSONPath filter-expression pattern hero-pillar-score.json's D1 already uses) rather than an array index, since delta ordering across ~19 same-day signals isn't stable.

INTERACTION PATTERN: Dialog (components/ui/dialog.tsx, Radix @radix-ui/react-dialog) — the established 29-call-site convention in this app (e.g. customer-detail.tsx's MarketplacePurchaseDialog) — chosen over a drawer/expand-in-place since no existing chart-click-to-detail pattern exists anywhere in components/m365-health/ or components/security-overview/ to match instead.

ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD (same TESTBED Assessment-role account other copilot-readiness manifests drive; customer_id=1, confirmed via SQL to hold real security engine signal-delta history).

D2 — the same delta entry's direction is 'fired' (confirmed live via shaneapp://executeSql), matching the direction badge the drill-down list renders next to this signal's label.
